events.title: Ambush at the Pharmacy
events.body: Three bandits step from a gutted pharmacy. One carries a hunting bow; the others watch your pack.

success.text: The formation breaks when their leader falls.

failure.text: They drive you back and cut deep before fleeing with supplies.

critical_success.text: You disarm the leader without taking a wound. The gang abandons a pistol.

critical_failure.text: You charge into a hidden blade.

success.text: You slip through a service alley before they close the trap.

failure.text: An arrow grazes you as you scramble away.

success.text: Your cough and confidence buy a wide path through them.

failure.text: They recognize the bluff and demand food.

events.title: The Sealed Bus
events.body: An evacuation bus rests on flat tires. Its rear door is wired shut from inside.

success.text: The frame yields. Emergency rations remain beneath a seat.

failure.text: The twisted frame snaps against your shoulder.

success.text: A corroded cable releases the door quietly.

failure.text: A dead battery vents into your face.

events.title: The Concrete Pack
events.body: Feral dogs fan across the road, testing your distance and fear.

success.text: The pack gives ground after the first hard strike.

failure.text: Teeth find your leg before the animals scatter.

outcome.text: They descend on the meat while you pass untouched.

success.text: You vault concrete and keep moving.

failure.text: You land badly but escape the pack.

events.title: Market Under Tarps
events.body: A dozen traders have built a temporary market beneath faded advertising tarps.

success.text: A trader values your warning about the eastern road.

failure.text: Your stories sound thin. You buy only a little water.

success.text: You recognize a working scanner under a pile of toys.

failure.text: The promising device crumbles after purchase.

events.title: Broken Overpass
events.body: The road ends at a collapsed span. Wind moves through exposed reinforcement bars.

success.text: You balance across and save hours.

failure.text: A beam turns underfoot. You catch yourself hard.

success.text: The detour is filthy but safe.

failure.text: You crawl through runoff until your muscles shake.

events.title: Curtain in the Window
events.body: A clean curtain moves on the third floor of a burned apartment block.

success.text: The occupant is long gone. A hidden cabinet remains.

failure.text: A rotten stair gives way beneath you.

outcome.text: You keep your distance and your strength.

events.title: The Siren Tower
events.body: A civil-defense siren begins to turn, drawing attention from every ruin nearby.

success.text: You stop the motor and salvage its charge pack.

failure.text: The mechanism arcs through your tools.

success.text: You put several blocks between yourself and the gathering shapes.

failure.text: The siren follows you in your thoughts long after it fades.

events.title: Municipal Cache
events.body: A yellow emergency locker is bolted beneath a courthouse stair.

success.text: The lock tears free with half the bracket.

failure.text: The bracket shears and cuts your palm.

success.text: The printed override still works.

failure.text: The final wrong turn seals the mechanism permanently.

events.title: Voice on Channel Nine
events.body: A child's recorded voice repeats coordinates and asks anyone listening to answer.

success.text: A real voice answers. Your directions guide a family toward the market.

failure.text: Only the recording replies. The silence afterward weighs on you.

success.text: The signal leads to an abandoned relay kit.

failure.text: Static consumes an hour and drains your focus.

events.title: Street Without a Bottom
events.body: A sinkhole has swallowed the intersection. A maintenance shelf is visible below.

success.text: Your boots land on sound pavement.

failure.text: The edge crumbles and you slam into concrete.

success.text: The shelf holds tools and a sealed canteen.

failure.text: The shelf collapses, but the rope saves you.

events.title: Toll Across Nothing
events.body: A barricade cuts across the salt. Armed collectors demand payment for a road they did not build.

success.text: The collectors scatter and leave ammunition behind.

failure.text: A club catches your ribs before you escape.

success.text: They accept one ration and warn you about the crater road.

failure.text: They take food and water before opening the gate.

success.text: The salt haze hides your detour.

failure.text: The long loop cooks you inside your clothes.

events.title: Water on the Horizon
events.body: A blue line trembles ahead where no map marks water.

success.text: The mirage hides an old rain trap with one sealed bottle.

failure.text: You chase light across empty salt.

choices.label: Check the sun and your tracks

success.text: You hold the true course and lose no time.

failure.text: The glare defeats every reference point.

events.title: Sunken Tanker
events.body: A fuel tanker rests axle-deep in salt, its rear compartment still sealed.

success.text: Inside are road flares and a frame pack.

failure.text: Pressurized fumes ignite against hot metal.

success.text: You vent the compartment and recover a shotgun.

failure.text: The instruments lie; you retreat coughing.

events.title: The Moving Wall
events.body: A brown wall of dust erases the northern sky and races toward you.

success.text: You endure the roar beneath chained steel.

failure.text: Dust fills every seam and tears at your lungs.

success.text: You slide into concrete as the storm arrives.

failure.text: The front catches you in open ground.

events.title: Circle of Bones
events.body: Human bones have been arranged around a fresh boot print.

success.text: The pattern marks thin salt over a chemical pit.

failure.text: You understand only after the crust breaks.

success.text: A careful step earns useful leather and hidden rounds.

failure.text: The salt collapses beneath one leg.

events.title: Convoy of Mirrors
events.body: Three armored carts approach, mirrors flashing coded light.

success.text: The convoy trades water and ammunition for road news.

failure.text: Your wrong sequence resembles a threat. They fire wide and pass.

success.text: They pass without seeing you.

failure.text: You remain pinned in hot metal for an hour.

events.title: Solar Field
events.body: Rows of cracked panels still turn toward the sun with insect precision.

success.text: You recover valuable components without waking the grid.

failure.text: Stored current throws you onto the salt.

success.text: Shade and quiet restore a little strength.

failure.text: The tracking motors shift and expose you to the heat.

events.title: Fresh Crater
events.body: The road skirts a crater whose glassy floor clicks as it cools.

success.text: A survey case contains radiation treatment.

failure.text: A hot pocket doses you before the scanner reacts.

events.title: Numbers in the Static
events.body: Your receiver repeats a string of numbers beneath the wind noise.

success.text: The numbers map a supply canister buried nearby.

failure.text: Hours of repetition leave you unfocused.

choices.label: Use it only as a bearing

success.text: The signal keeps you on the shortest route.

failure.text: Interference leads you in a slow circle.

events.title: Fire After Sunset
events.body: A small fire burns beside the road. A lone traveler keeps both hands visible.

success.text: You exchange warnings and sleep in turns.

failure.text: The traveler leaves with one of your cans while you sleep.

success.text: You leave the fire behind without revealing yourself.

failure.text: Loose salt announces you. Both of you retreat nervous and tired.

events.title: Red Water
events.body: The water around your boots clouds red as marsh leeches rise from the mud.

success.text: A heated blade drives the parasites back.

failure.text: Several attach before you reach dry ground.

success.text: Speed keeps them from finding purchase.

failure.text: You stumble in the black water.

events.title: The Ferryman
events.body: A narrow skiff waits at the drowned crossing. Its masked owner asks for a story, not payment.

choices.label: Tell the truth about your road

success.text: The ferryman carries you across and gives you tonic.

failure.text: Your story bores them. You cross by wading.

choices.label: Read the current and cross alone

success.text: You find a submerged service path.

failure.text: The current steals a bottle from your pack.

events.title: Skiffs in the Reeds
events.body: Low boats slide from both banks. Masked raiders level patched shotguns.

success.text: The nearest skiff overturns and the rest retreat.

failure.text: Shot tears through reeds and you.

success.text: The raiders hesitate long enough for you to disappear.

failure.text: They take your medicine as proof of passage.

outcome.text: Thick smoke hides your retreat among the reeds.

events.title: Clinic on Stilts
events.body: A faded medical cross marks a building balanced above the flood.

success.text: The pharmacy cabinet still holds a medkit.

failure.text: A wet beam gives way beneath you.

success.text: You find sealed supplies without disturbing mold.

failure.text: Spores leave you feverish.

events.title: Bridge of Vines
events.body: A service bridge has become a living rope of roots and rusted cable.

success.text: You reach the far bank before the structure starts moving.

failure.text: A cable snaps and throws you against the rail.

success.text: The reinforced line makes the crossing methodical.

failure.text: The knots hold, but the long work drains you.

events.title: Lights Beneath the Water
events.body: Cold lights move below the flooded road in a deliberate grid.

success.text: The lights mark a submerged emergency cache.

failure.text: The pattern leads into contaminated silt.

success.text: You ignore the lure and maintain pace.

failure.text: The difficult bank route exhausts you.

events.title: Smoke from a Hut
events.body: Thin blue smoke rises from a hut with no visible path to it.

success.text: An herbalist trades food and tonic for news.

failure.text: No one answers, but hidden eyes follow you away.

success.text: The hut is abandoned. Useful filters hang over the hearth.

failure.text: A warning dart finds your shoulder.

events.title: Filter Station
events.body: A municipal filter station hums weakly above the waterline.

success.text: The pumps cough out several bottles of clean water.

failure.text: A ruptured line sprays contaminated water.

success.text: You recover useful parts and a sealed filter mask.

failure.text: The housing shifts onto your hand.

events.title: Body in a Raincoat
events.body: A body in a bright raincoat is tied upright to a navigation post.

success.text: A waterproof pocket contains a map and radiation tablets.

failure.text: The swollen body ruptures when moved.

outcome.text: You mark the place and move on quietly.

events.title: Black Rain
events.body: The reeds flatten as warm black rain begins to fall.

choices.label: Build cover from a road sign

success.text: The metal roof turns the worst of the rain.

failure.text: The shelter fails and pins you in contaminated mud.

success.text: You reach dense cover before the rain strengthens.

failure.text: The storm overtakes you in the open.

events.title: Evacuation Order
events.body: Security drones descend from a loading bay, repeating an order to leave the restricted zone.

success.text: The swarm drops harmlessly. Their cells are valuable.

failure.text: A stun pulse throws you against concrete.

success.text: You cross the yard between scanning arcs.

failure.text: A drone tags you with electrified wire.

events.title: Generator Three
events.body: A backup generator still turns behind a locked mesh cage.

success.text: Stable power opens an emergency locker.

failure.text: A backfeed burns through your gloves.

success.text: You strip a heavy bundle of useful metal.

failure.text: The spinning assembly catches your sleeve.

events.title: Claimed Warehouse
events.body: A disciplined scavenger crew watches you from a warehouse roof.

success.text: They accept the trade and add a ration to your pack.

failure.text: They search your pack and take valuable medicine.

success.text: The brief fight earns hard respect and ammunition.

failure.text: Their crew intervenes before you can recover.

success.text: Freight cars conceal your route.

failure.text: You crawl beneath rusted cars until your muscles fail.

events.title: The Moving Line
events.body: A factory conveyor lurches to life, carrying sealed crates toward a crusher.

choices.label: Grab a crate before the crusher

success.text: The crate holds protective padding and shells.

failure.text: Your arm catches between rollers.

choices.label: Stop the line at its panel

success.text: The emergency stop preserves several supply crates.

failure.text: The labeled controls no longer match the wiring.

events.title: Executive Shelter
events.body: A reinforced office door bears the faded words SHELTER CAPACITY 8.

success.text: Old personnel notes reveal the code. A medical satchel hangs inside.

failure.text: The final attempt triggers a chemical lockout.

success.text: You peel back paneling and reach stored rations.

failure.text: Insulation fibers fill your mouth and eyes.

events.title: Chemical Fire
events.body: Blue flame moves across a loading dock toward stacked pressure drums.

success.text: Foam buries the fire before the drums rupture.

failure.text: A valve bursts and sprays burning residue.

success.text: You clear the blast radius in time.

failure.text: The pressure wave throws you hard.

events.title: Knocking in the Tank
events.body: Something knocks three times from inside a sealed water tank.

success.text: A dehydrated engineer emerges and gives you a scanner.

failure.text: Contaminated pressure sprays from the seal.

success.text: The knocking is a loose valve, not a person. You safely drain clean water.

failure.text: The uncertain sound follows you through the factory.

events.title: Crane Above the Yard
events.body: A cargo pallet hangs above the route, suspended by one corroded cable.

success.text: You cross before the cable parts.

failure.text: The pallet clips you as it falls.

success.text: The pallet contains sealed tools and food.

failure.text: The controls jam and waste precious time.

events.title: Names on the Lockers
events.body: Workers scratched family names into a row of sealed lockers.

success.text: It holds practical gear without personal remains.

failure.text: The latch breaks and cuts you.

outcome.text: You let the dead keep what little remains theirs.

events.title: Red Shift Alarm
events.body: Red lights pulse and factory doors begin sealing in sequence.

success.text: You freeze the doors and choose the shortest exit.

failure.text: The final door catches your pack and crushes supplies.

success.text: You slide through the last gap.

failure.text: Steel catches your shoulder before reversing.

events.title: Pilgrims of the Flash
events.body: Robed figures kneel toward the fused horizon. Their exposed skin shines with old burns.

success.text: They accept you as a passing pilgrim and share protective tablets.

failure.text: A wrong phrase marks you as profane.

success.text: Their ceremonial weapons fail against real force.

failure.text: Glass blades open several wounds.

success.text: The procession passes without looking down.

failure.text: The reflected heat drains you while you hide.

events.title: Needle Storm
events.body: The wind lifts splinters of fused glass from the plain.

success.text: Layered cloth turns most of the cutting dust.

failure.text: Glass finds every opening.

success.text: You dive beneath armored wreckage.

failure.text: The storm catches you meters from cover.

events.title: Bunker 41
events.body: A blast door protrudes from the glass, its keypad still blinking.

success.text: Inside, civil-defense supplies remain sealed.

failure.text: The lock vents irradiated coolant.

success.text: The cramped shaft reaches an equipment room.

failure.text: A hinge tears free and crushes your foot.

events.title: Shadow Without a Body
events.body: A human shadow is burned into a standing wall. Fresh footprints end beside it.

success.text: You find a sheltered pack and signs the owner turned back.

failure.text: The tracks circle a radioactive pocket.

outcome.text: Some questions are too expensive to answer.

events.title: Hot Metal
events.body: A fist-sized fragment smolders in a new crater, too regular to be stone.

success.text: The fragment is a fallen drone core worth stripping.

failure.text: The casing opens and doses you.

choices.label: Mark the crater and move on

success.text: You resist the lure of rare salvage.

failure.text: Curiosity costs time even without touching it.

events.title: The Last Pilgrim
events.body: A dying pilgrim offers a sealed ampoule if you carry their metal prayer disk east.

success.text: They trust your promise and die at peace.

failure.text: They doubt your words and break the ampoule before dying.

outcome.text: The pilgrim survives long enough to guide you around a hot zone.

events.title: Antenna Forest
events.body: Hundreds of thin antennas rise from the glass and hum in the same key.

success.text: The pattern points directly toward the Underrail entrance.

failure.text: The overlapping frequencies leave you disoriented.

success.text: You avoid the strongest fields.

failure.text: A discharge crosses your path.

events.title: Crawler Carcass
events.body: A massive cargo crawler lies fused to the plain, its armored belly intact.

success.text: You uncover armor and rifle ammunition.

failure.text: A stressed plate folds onto you.

success.text: The cabin contains water and a signal compass.

failure.text: Broken glass opens your forearm.

events.title: Warm Spring
events.body: Clear water bubbles through a crack in the fused ground, warm enough to steam.

success.text: The water is mineral-heavy but clean.

failure.text: The harmless reading masks a radioactive pulse.

success.text: Heat loosens your aching muscles.

failure.text: You stay too long in exposed ground.

events.title: City of Reflections
events.body: Fused building shells multiply your reflection into a crowd.

success.text: You maintain direction through the mirrored streets.

failure.text: Reflections turn an hour into three.

success.text: The cooler route preserves your strength.

failure.text: A glass shelf collapses under you.

events.title: Breathing in the Dark
events.body: Three sets of careful breathing follow you beyond the reach of your light.

success.text: You anticipate the ambush and seize their ammunition.

failure.text: A blade enters from the blind side.

success.text: Your pursuers lose you among service alcoves.

failure.text: You collide with concrete in the dark.

success.text: They accept two rounds and reveal a safe tunnel.

failure.text: They take the offer as proof you carry more.

events.title: Train with Warm Windows
events.body: A subway train stands on dead rails. Warm yellow light fills one carriage.

success.text: A hidden family shares a meal and tunnel directions.

failure.text: The light dies. No door opens.

success.text: The carriage is an abandoned decoy hiding supplies.

failure.text: A wire trap throws you from the roof.

events.title: Rising Tunnel Water
events.body: A surge of black water advances down the tunnel, carrying debris and dead lights.

success.text: You pull yourself above the surge.

failure.text: The water slams you into the wall.

success.text: You reach high ground one breath ahead.

failure.text: The surge catches and rolls you through rubble.

events.title: Platform Council
events.body: A small settlement blocks the platform with shields and questions.

success.text: The council grants passage and a field medkit.

failure.text: They allow passage only after taking a ration.

success.text: You repair their pump and receive a purifier ampoule.

failure.text: The repair fails and costs several useful parts.

events.title: The Wrong Track
events.body: A mechanical route board points east while your signal compass points into a sealed west tunnel.

success.text: The sealed tunnel is the old Citadel service line.

failure.text: Interference leads you to a collapsed loop.

success.text: Faded transfer marks reveal the true route.

failure.text: The obsolete map sends you through a long maintenance loop.

events.title: Nest of Cable
events.body: Stripped cable and cloth fill a ticket office. Something inside copies your footsteps.

success.text: An ash stalker flees, leaving its scavenged nest.

failure.text: The creature attacks through the ticket slot.

success.text: The mimic does not recognize you as prey.

failure.text: A copied stumble draws it out.

events.title: The Last Vending Machine
events.body: One vending machine glows at the end of an otherwise dead platform.

success.text: The machine releases old but sealed food and water.

failure.text: The anti-tamper cell shocks you.

success.text: Plastic yields and the shelves are yours.

failure.text: Safety glass cuts both hands.

events.title: Ceiling Dust
events.body: Pebbles begin falling from a ceiling already bowed by surface impacts.

success.text: A steel post holds long enough for you to pass.

failure.text: The ceiling drops as you retreat.

success.text: A cable duct leads around the collapse.

failure.text: The bypass dead-ends after a punishing crawl.

events.title: Green Signal
events.body: A rail signal turns green as you approach, though no grid should remain active.

success.text: The line is a guide laid by Citadel engineers.

failure.text: The line feeds an old security trap.

success.text: The signal dies and the tunnel stays quiet.

failure.text: A capacitor discharges through the cutters.

events.title: Door Marked EAST CITADEL
events.body: A blast door carries the first intact Citadel marking you have seen.

success.text: The maintenance housing contains a usable access core.

failure.text: The mechanism consumes your tools and remains sealed.

success.text: You record the sequence for the final gate.

failure.text: The code changes before you understand its cycle.

events.title: Wandering Trader
events.body: A trader pushes a one-wheeled cart and offers a fair exchange before either of you asks names.

success.text: Your eye for value earns food and medicine.

failure.text: You receive a single ration for your parts.

success.text: The trader's warning sharpens your attention.

failure.text: Their directions contradict themselves.

events.title: Acid Rain
events.body: Rain pits exposed metal and raises white smoke from the road.

success.text: Layered debris keeps the worst rain off.

failure.text: The shelter leaks caustic water.

success.text: You outlast the short storm.

failure.text: The rain burns through your outer layers.

events.title: Abandoned Pack
events.body: A clean-looking backpack sits in the center of the road with no tracks around it.

success.text: You disarm a wire and claim the pack's supplies.

failure.text: A snap charge fills your hand with fragments.

outcome.text: The pack remains in the road behind you.

events.title: Injured Stranger
events.body: A stranger sits against a marker stone, pressing cloth to a deep wound.

success.text: They survive and give you a route token.

failure.text: The wound is beyond your skill, but they do not die alone.

outcome.text: They drink, thank you, and point out a safer trail.

events.title: Map Under Glass
events.body: A weatherproof route map stands beside the road, amended by dozens of travelers.

success.text: A consistent route emerges from the layers.

failure.text: The contradictions cost more time than they save.

success.text: Leaving useful knowledge restores a little purpose.

failure.text: Your scratched note disappears among hundreds.

events.title: A Quiet Mile
events.body: For once, the road is empty and the wind carries no warning.

outcome.text: The quiet mile gives your body room to recover.

success.text: A drainage grate hides useful parts.

failure.text: The search spends the calm without reward.

events.title: Roadside Grave
events.body: A cairn is marked with a name, a date, and the words THEY KEPT WALKING.

outcome.text: You carry the words with you.

success.text: A waterproof emergency ration was left for travelers.

failure.text: There is nothing but the dead and your embarrassment.

events.title: Fallen Supply Pod
events.body: A small parachute is tangled around a recent supply pod.

success.text: The coded latch yields medical supplies.

failure.text: The pod broadcasts a recovery alarm.

success.text: In cover, you open it without competition.

failure.text: The pod tears a muscle and stays exposed.

events.title: Broken Courier Bike
events.body: A courier bicycle leans against a marker, chain snapped but cargo box locked.

choices.label: Repair the chain long enough to ride

success.text: A short ride saves strength before the chain fails again.

failure.text: The repair consumes wire and patience.

success.text: The box contains ammunition and a ration.

failure.text: The lock breaks your improvised tool.

events.title: Mutant Crows
events.body: Hairless crows line the road and repeat fragments of human speech.

success.text: Their stolen phrase leads to a hidden camp cache.

failure.text: They lure you toward a radiation pocket.

success.text: The flock scatters from your noise.

failure.text: They rake your face before taking flight.

events.title: Clear Sky
events.body: The clouds break. For a few minutes, the world has color again.

outcome.text: The rare sunlight restores your sense of direction.

success.text: You identify the safest line ahead.

failure.text: Distant movement keeps you watching too long.

events.title: Wire at Ankle Height
events.body: A glint of wire crosses the trail just above your boots.

success.text: You recover the trigger and useful wire.

failure.text: The snare whips you off your feet.

success.text: You pass without disturbing it.

failure.text: A second hidden line catches your pack.

events.title: Dust and Distance
events.body: The road offers no shelter, no company, and no useful lie about how far remains.

success.text: You preserve your rhythm through the empty stretch.

failure.text: The featureless road drains more than expected.

success.text: You find a usable ration beneath a marker.

failure.text: The search wastes strength.

events.title: The East Citadel Gate
events.body: Floodlights pin you against the final blast door. A loudspeaker demands a valid challenge response.

choices.label: Answer with the recovered gate code

success.text: The first lock accepts your reconstruction.

failure.text: The wrong response triggers warning fire.

critical_success.text: The code opens the personnel channel and identifies you as expected.

choices.label: Convince the guard you carry vital intelligence

success.text: The guard delays execution and moves you to secondary screening.

failure.text: The argument buys only seconds before a stun round lands.

events.title: Secondary Screening
events.body: An armored Warden machine rolls from the gate. Its scanner declares your contamination unacceptable.

success.text: The Warden blinds itself and exposes the manual gate control.

failure.text: The machine identifies the attack and fires.

success.text: The damaged assembly folds and the Warden crashes aside.

failure.text: Armor turns your strike before the counterattack lands.

success.text: You reach the manual controls while the turret searches empty ground.

failure.text: The tracking beam catches your movement.

events.title: One Person Through
events.body: The inner gate opens a hand's width. The mechanism is failing, the Warden is recovering, and the clean lights of the Citadel wait beyond.

success.text: Metal screams, then yields. You cross into clean air before it seals.

failure.text: The mechanism closes while the Warden fires through the gap.

critical_success.text: You tear the failing mechanism free and leave the passage open behind you. The road ends in victory.

critical_failure.text: The gate crushes your last attempt as the Warden fires.

success.text: The ancient controller accepts one final command. The Citadel admits you.

failure.text: The controller rejects the command and energizes the frame.

critical_success.text: The override restores the entire gate cycle. You walk through under green lights.

critical_failure.text: A final short crosses the control frame and stops your heart.

choices.label: Order the guard to open it now

success.text: Your voice carries every death and mile behind it. Someone inside chooses to believe you.

failure.text: No one answers before the Warden reacquires its target.

critical_success.text: The guard breaks protocol, opens the gate, and calls you by name. You have reached the Citadel.

critical_failure.text: Your words disappear beneath the Warden's final shot.
